lane.definition:
n. a narrow way or road
n. a well-defined track or path; for e.g. swimmers or lines of traffic
lane.translation: n. 小路, 巷, 弄, 单行道

lane method.translation: [医] 累恩氏法, 直接离心浮集法(检钩虫卵)

lane's band.translation: [医] 累恩氏带, 累恩氏纽结(回肠纽结)

lane's disease.translation: [医] 累恩氏病, 慢性肠停滞

lane's kink.translation: [医] 累恩氏纽结, 累恩氏带(回肠纽结)

lane's operation.translation: [医] 累恩氏手术(一种回肠吻合术)

lane's prince albert.translation: [网络] 巷的阿尔伯特王子

lane-lannelongue operation.translation: [医] 累-兰二氏手术(脑减压手术)

lanes.definition:
n. a narrow way or road
n. a well-defined track or path; for e.g. swimmers or lines of traffic
lanes.translation: n. 小路( lane的复数形式 ); 车道; 航道; 分道

lanesborough.translation: [地名] [爱尔兰] 莱恩斯伯勒

laney.definition: n. United States educator who founded the first private school for Black students in Augusta, Georgia (1854-1933)
